headline: Baron Capital Backs Vail Resorts Board in Oasis Proxy Battle
summary: Baron Capital has thrown its support behind Vail Resorts' board of directors in an ongoing proxy contest against activist investment fund Oasis Management.
why: Shareholder proxy disputes can reshape board leadership, capital allocation, and operational strategies at leisure giants.

impacts.name: Vail Resorts
impacts.why: Baron Capital backed management's board nominees in a proxy contest with Oasis.
